# Shah Agro Limited

> Shah Agro Limited is a jute manufacturer and exporter based in Bangladesh, producing jute yarn, jute sliver and jute sacking bags with a monthly production capacity of over 7,000 MT.

## Products
- **Jute Yarn** — https://www.shahagro.com/products/yarn
  Grades: CRP, CRX, CRT, CRM, CB, CRP Hessian/Sacking, Wilton, Axminister, Mining Fuse, Tatami, Cable, Espadrille, Rope-making and horticulture yarns.
  Counts: 6–100 Lbs, single and multi-ply. Specialty forms: mini spool, coreless, hangs, scanned, spliced joints, staggered.
- **Jute Sliver** — https://www.shahagro.com/products/sliver
  Carded and drawn jute fibre in continuous strands; the primary raw material for spinning jute yarn.
- **Jute Sacking Bags & Cloth** — https://www.shahagro.com/products/sacking-bag
  Heavy-duty woven jute fabric and bags for packaging rice, wheat, coffee, cocoa and potatoes. Breathable and biodegradable.

## Production process
The site documents each stage: seeding, harvesting, curing & retting, buying & grading, manufacturing, and packing & export.
- https://www.shahagro.com/journey/seeding
- https://www.shahagro.com/journey/harvesting
- https://www.shahagro.com/journey/curing-retting
- https://www.shahagro.com/journey/buying
- https://www.shahagro.com/journey/manufacturing
- https://www.shahagro.com/journey/packing-exporting

## Export markets
Belgium, Germany, Iran, Turkey, Uzbekistan, Indonesia, Egypt, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Ivory Coast, Sudan, Morocco, China, Pakistan, India and Nepal.
